purpose: Traceable measurements and explicit assumptions for Porsche cooling-fan reconstruction, CFD, FEA and manufacturing studies
record_rules: Store each claim separately; conflicting sources are not averaged into an accepted value.
Unknown values are null, with status unavailable or not_measured. Zero is a physical value.
Preserve the source value and unit in addition to any normalized value.
A value does not become a manufacturing tolerance because it is printed with decimal places.
A nominal commercial diameter is not a scan-scale calibration.
A derivative must cite its input claim IDs, formula, assumptions and propagated uncertainty.
Source authority, measurement method, verification status and design admission are separate fields.
Every applicable-model statement must name the engine and assembly variant; unknown year or casting remains unknown.
No accepted simulation input may silently inherit a quantity from a different Porsche variant or generic benchmark.
Preserve raw scans and record transformations and geometric repairs as versioned derivatives.
Repository code licensing does not relicense third-party meshes, drawings, figures or data.

coordinate_system.A: Functional rotation axis fitted to verified machined cylindrical features at multiple axial stations
coordinate_system.B: Independently fitted mounting/abutment plane; retain perpendicularity error relative to A
coordinate_system.C: Verified non-axisymmetric indexed feature used to define angular zero
coordinate_system.positive_z: Explicitly chosen through-flow direction, verified on actual assembly
coordinate_system.stagger_definition: Signed chord angle relative to the local tangential direction in the unwrapped cylindrical section
coordinate_system.rotation_definition: Signed omega plus clockwise/counter-clockwise and viewing direction

computed_quantities.warning: Use measured effective ratio or explicitly ignore slip
Circumferential speed alone is not local relative Mach number
Irregular spacing and installation produce additional spectral content
Specify measurement shaft and subtract only justified loss terms
Match stations, flow state and denominator; do not mix definitions
Density and volume-flow station must correspond
Conditional incompressible geometric similarity only; not between 935 and 993 designs
Corresponding map points and similarity requirements must hold
Impeller power law is not an alternator/electrical or total accessory power law
